papers.title: Determinants of mental health service utilization among young adults with anxiety disorders.
papers.abstract: Anxiety disorders are among the most prevalent mental health issues faced by young adults, who experience the highest lifetime prevalence of these conditions. Despite the increasing rates of anxiety disorders, mental health service utilization within this demographic remains notably low. This study aims to analyze the factors influencing mental health service utilization among young adults with anxiety disorders, distinguishing between early young adults (19-29 years) and late young adults (30-39 years), to propose tailored support strategies. Data from the 2021 National Mental Health Survey of Korea, which included 395 adults diagnosed with anxiety disorders, were analyzed. Complex sample logistic regression was used to assess how sociodemographic characteristics, health behaviors, and comorbid mental health issues impact service utilization. Among early young adults, higher education (odds ratio [OR] = 6.57), being married (OR = 7.02), and suicidal thoughts (OR = 29.42) were significantly associated with increased mental health service utilization. For late young adults, suicidal thoughts (OR = 10.79) and post-traumatic stress disorder (OR = 15.87) were significant predictors of higher service use, while alcohol use disorder was associated with lower service utilization (OR = 0.07). This study highlights the need to prioritize support for early young adults with lower education, single status, and suicidal thoughts, as well as late young adults with alcohol use disorder, post-traumatic stress disorder, or suicidal thoughts. Implementing these strategies may enhance mental health management and improve the overall quality of life for young adults.
papers.summary: 本研究利用2021年韓國全國心理健康調查數據，分析395名患有焦慮症的年輕成人（分為19-29歲早期與30-39歲晚期）使用心理健康服務的影響因素。研究發現，早期年輕成人中，較高學歷、已婚及有自殺意念者就醫率較高；晚期年輕成人中，自殺意念與創傷後壓力症候群會增加服務使用，而酒精使用障礙則顯著降低就醫意願。
papers.significance: 該研究揭示了不同年齡層年輕成人尋求心理健康協助的差異化因素，強調必須針對低學歷、單身且具自殺意念的早期年輕成人，以及合併酒精使用障礙、創傷後壓力症候群或自殺意念的晚期年輕成人，制定精準的介入與支持策略，以有效提升心理健康服務的利用率與整體生活品質。

papers.title: Perspectives of eating disorder clinicians on their professional well-being in the context of clinical care: a qualitative examination.
papers.abstract: Clinicians who provide clinical care for eating disorders (EDs) report stress, burnout, and system-level considerations that contribute to challenges with professional well-being. Yet, there are also positive factors that keep ED clinicians in their roles, though the factors that drive positive workplace well-being have been relatively under-explored in the literature. To elucidate both factors contributing to challenges and positive experiences in the workforce, we set out to explore the perceptions of eating disorder (ED) clinicians about engaging in care for individuals with EDs, and their experiences with their own well-being in the context of providing clinical care. A total of 27 clinicians working in ED services took part in an individual semi-structured interview. Clinicians were asked to share their experiences working with individuals who have EDs, their reflections on factors that contribute to workplace well-being, how they think about culture in their work, and for recommendations to improve clinician well-being and overall clinical care for EDs. Participants also completed online questionnaires assessing professional quality of life and vicarious resilience. Using reflexive thematic analysis, five main themes were identified: (1) Lack of ED knowledge and understanding within the public and healthcare system; (2) Barriers and limitations to providing accessible, appropriate treatment; (3) The value of professional relationships, support, and collaboration; (4) The association between confidence and complexity of clinical presentations; and (5) The links between clinicians' personal and professional well-being and experiences with provision of care. Our study highlights that when ED clinicians are able to provide care in a manner that is consistent with their professional desires and beliefs, they associate this with their own professional well-being. Conversely, acting in discordance with these values may occur alongside feelings of burnout and moral distress. The results underscore the importance of ED education and training within the broader healthcare context, and highlight clinicians' lack of confidence in treating complex clinical cases, as well as a perceived reciprocal relationship between professional and personal well-being as factors that can contribute to well-being in the ED workforce. Not applicable.
papers.summary: 本研究透過訪談27名飲食失調（ED）臨床醫生，探討其在提供臨床照護時的專業福祉體驗。研究識別出五個主要主題：大眾與醫療體系對ED認知不足、提供適當治療的障礙、專業關係與支持的重要性、臨床自信度與病例複雜度的關聯，以及個人與專業福祉的相互影響。當醫生的實踐與其專業信念一致時，專業福祉較高；反之則易導致職業倦怠與道德困境。
papers.significance: 此研究凸顯了在廣泛醫療環境中加強ED教育與培訓的迫切性，並點出臨床醫生面對複雜病例時的自信心不足問題。透過理解臨床醫生的專業與個人福祉的雙向關聯，研究結果為醫療機構制定支持策略、減少人才流失並提升整體ED照護品質提供了重要的實證基礎。

papers.title: Dissociable individuals' neural responses to morality and competence evaluations during the anticipatory and consummatory stages.
papers.abstract: Previous studies have shown that individuals assign differential weight to morality versus competence during feedback processing. However, these studies failed to disentangle the anticipatory and consummatory stages from feedback processing. Therefore, using event-related potentials, the current study adapted an effort-based prosocial task to explore individuals' neural response to morality and competence evaluations in both the anticipatory and consummatory stages. Behaviorally, an interaction effect between evaluation valence and evaluation dimension showed that competence evaluations were rated as more negative than morality evaluations when evaluations were negative, while competence evaluations were rated as more arousing than morality evaluations when evaluations were positive. The ERP results revealed that, during the anticipatory stage, the Cue-P3 was larger when participants received competence cues relative to morality cues in positive contexts. Conversely, the SPN was larger after receiving morality cues compared to competence cues in positive contexts. In the consummatory stages, the LPP was larger for morality evaluations compared to competence evaluations, regardless of positive or negative evaluations. In conclusion, these results provide evidence for a dissociable effect between morality and competence evaluations during both anticipatory and consummatory stages.
papers.summary: 本研究利用事件相關電位（ERP）技術，探討個體在預期與消費階段對道德與能力評價的神經反應差異。行為結果顯示，負面評價中能力評價比道德評價更負面，而正面評價中能力評價則引發更高的覺醒度。ERP結果表明，在預期階段的正面情境下，能力線索比道德線索引發更大的Cue-P3，而道德線索則引發更大的SPN；在消費階段，無論正負面評價，道德評價均比能力評價引發更大的晚正電位（LPP）。
papers.significance: 此研究首次從神經層面證實了個體在處理道德與能力評價時，於預期與消費階段存在明顯的分離效應。這不僅釐清了過去文獻無法區分反饋處理階段的局限，也為理解人類在社會互動與決策過程中，如何針對不同維度的社會特質分配認知資源提供了關鍵的腦科學證據。

papers.title: Individual differences in lexical decision speed for Chinese single-character words are predicted by ND250 peak latency.
papers.abstract: Reading is a fundamental cognitive skill in modern society that relies on the rapid recognition of visual word forms. Event-related potentials (ERPs) provide a powerful tool for investigating the neural dynamics underlying visual word recognition. Establishing neural-behavior relationships is crucial for characterizing the neural mechanisms underlying specific aspects of behavior. The present study examined whether individual differences in lexical decision speed are associated with the temporal dynamics of the ND250-an ERP component reflecting neural differentiation between real words and pseudowords (or between high- and low-frequency words). Eighty-eight native Chinese readers performed a lexical decision task on real and pseudo Chinese characters while electroencephalographic (EEG) activity was recorded. All real characters used as stimuli were monomorphemic single-character words. Consistent with previous research, pseudo-characters elicited a robust ND250 over occipito-temporal scalp regions, with source estimates localized to the fusiform gyrus. Critically, ND250 peak latency showed a strong positive correlation with reaction times across participants: individuals with earlier ND250 peaks responded faster in the lexical decision task. Hierarchical regression analyses further demonstrated that ND250 latency uniquely predicted lexical decision speed even when earlier (N170) and later (PD300) ERP components were included as predictors. This relationship was consistently observed for both simple and complex characters. Together, these findings suggest that the ND250 serves as an important neurophysiological marker of orthographic processing and represents a key neural mechanism underlying individual differences in the speed of recognizing written words.
papers.summary: 本研究探討中文單字詞彙判斷速度的個體差異與腦電成分ND250的關聯。透過88名中文母語者進行真偽字詞彙判斷任務並記錄腦電圖，研究發現假字在枕顳區誘發了強烈的ND250反應，且源定位於梭狀回。關鍵結果顯示，ND250的峰值潛伏期與受試者的反應時間呈顯著正相關，即ND250峰值出現越早的個體，其詞彙判斷速度越快。層次迴歸分析證實，在控制N170與PD300等成分後，ND250潛伏期仍能獨特預測詞彙判斷速度，且此現象不受漢字複雜度影響。
papers.significance: 此研究確立了ND250作為正字法處理重要神經生理指標的地位，揭示了書面文字辨識速度個體差異的關鍵大腦機制。該發現不僅深化了對視覺詞彙識別神經動態的理論理解，也為未來利用腦電指標預測或評估閱讀認知能力提供了堅實的實證基礎。

papers.title: Psychophysiological stress response to the Open TSST VR-Y in a youth sample: a feasibility study.
papers.abstract: The Open TSST VR is a freely available virtual reality adaptation of the Trier Social Stress Test (TSST) designed to enable standardized, adaptable, and scalable stress research. However, its feasibility as a stressor has only been validated in adult populations. Here, we present results from a study using the Open TSST VR for Youths (VR-Y), a version adapted to adolescent populations. We compared self-ratings, endocrine, and heart rate responses to the VR-Y stress condition and a placebo TSST (active control condition without social-evaluative threat). A total of 37 individuals aged 13-18 years (M age = 16.19 ± 1.72; 46% female sex, all cisgender) were randomly assigned to one of the two conditions. Significant stress responses in all parameters over time did not differ between the conditions. Including sex in exploratory analyses resulted in a greater desire to leave the situation among girls in the stress condition. Descriptively, we detected more cortisol responders in the stress condition than in the active control condition (1.61 nmol/l criterion: 31% vs 22%, and 2.19 nmol criterion: 25% vs 6%); statistically, the difference was not significant. Because of the limited cortisol responses observed, possibilities are discussed as to how uncontrollability or threat could be increased in order to further enhance the VR-Ys stress-inducing potential. Overall, these results indicate that the Open TSST VR-Y shows some promise as an experimental stress paradigm for participants aged 13 and older. Longitudinal and collaborative experimental stress research will be important to further optimize and validate its effectiveness.
papers.summary: 本研究探討了開放式特里爾社會壓力測試虛擬實境青少年版（Open TSST VR-Y）作為實驗性壓力範式的可行性。研究將37名13至18歲的青少年隨機分配至VR-Y壓力組與安慰劑對照組，並比較其自我評分、內分泌及心率反應。結果顯示，兩組在整體壓力反應參數上無顯著差異，但描述性數據指出壓力組有較多皮質醇反應者。探索性分析亦發現，壓力組中的女性有更強烈的離開意願。整體而言，VR-Y在青少年群體中展現出初步潛力，但仍需進一步優化。
papers.significance: 此研究首次將Open TSST VR-Y應用於青少年樣本，填補了虛擬實境壓力測試在青少年群體中驗證的空白。儘管目前的壓力誘發反應未達顯著統計差異，但該研究為未來如何透過提升不可控性或威脅性來強化VR壓力范式提供了明確的改進方向，有助於推動具備標準化、可擴展性及跨年齡層適用性的壓力研究發展。
